item.title: Checkerboard has moved!
item.description: Checkerboard has moved! In order to get faster load times, Checkerboard will now be hosted on Neocites. For those of you visiting though nekOS, this shouldn't be a big change, but for those of you who visit through the standalone site, please update your links and bookmarks

item.title: Pet Personality and Favorite Info
item.description: Added a ton of new petz, and also started adding pet personality and favorite info! Right now this data is only available for my Catz, but it will slowly be added to all my petz as I convert them to my new data system

item.title: Random Pet Box and New Filters
item.description: Several new site features! First, I replaced the barely used cbox with a random pet box. I also added 3 new filters under the settings menu, allowing you to filter by content on the pet pages. Finally, I made some minor tweaks the site style, especially the mobile layout. It should kick in earlier and look a little better. And, as always, I added some more new petz.`,

item.title: Final Batch of Advent Petz
item.description: Added all of my advent petz in a reasonable amount of time, yay!

item.title: More Advent Petz
item.description: Added another batch of advent petz.

item.title: New Show Ribbon Template
item.description: Added a couple batches of advent petz. Also updated the show records template to use big fancy ribbons if there's room, and added a new "view show records" button to the homepage so you can view all my champs on a single page.

item.title: Show All Petz Icons
item.description: Added a ton of previously acquired petz. Also added a checkbox to let you show all the pet icons

item.title: Bug Fixes
item.description: Moved the site, fixed a bug when the window resizes, and added a couple petz.

item.title: Checkerboard is back!
item.description: Checkerboard is back! I had a lot of fun putting this site together, so I hope you have a fun time looking at all my lovely petz!
